reason.en: The tank, its valves and the emergency stop of this timed cycle are simulated, and the hardware track of the plant lessons opens in a later release, once plant I/O mode has been measured on a learner board.
reason.es: El tanque, sus válvulas y la parada de emergencia de este ciclo temporizado son simulados, y la ruta de hardware de las lecciones de planta se abre en una versión posterior, cuando el modo de E/S de planta se haya medido en una placa del estudiante.

instead.en: Complete it in Simulation, where the tank, its valves and the emergency stop are part of the scenario.
